notes: Each category has one base node and four to five research paths (the original 16 categories have a fifth path added in this version; the 3 new categories have four).
The game generates levels VI–XI from each path's fifth node.
Cross-dependencies are additional prerequisites beyond the path's direct predecessor.
New nodes only depend on original nodes, so the dependency graph stays acyclic.
Descriptions are in base_description, path_descriptions (parallel to paths) and capstone_descriptions_by_category.
